name: exControl panel MCM
summary: This EA is a demonstration of the MCM Control Panel, providing a graphical menu interface on the chart. It initializes a customizable control panel with user-defined colors and font size, then processes custom chart events for multi-currency monitoring. The EA itself does not execute any trades; it serves purely as a UI utility for market watch event display.
summary_zh: 这个EA是MCM控制面板的演示程序，在图表上提供图形化菜单界面。它初始化一个可自定义颜色和字号的控盘面板，并处理自定义图表事件用于多币种监控。该EA本身不执行任何交易，纯粹作为市场观察事件显示的界面工具。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个图表控制面板工具。它通过InitControlPanelMCM函数初始化MCM面板，支持自定义背景色、字体色、选中色和字号等外观参数。在OnChartEvent中处理CHARTEVENT_CUSTOM及以上的自定义事件，当收到自定义事件时打印事件ID、交易品种、时间框架描述和价格信息，这暗示其可用于多币种市场观察场景。DeinitControlPanelMCM在EA卸载时清理面板资源。核心逻辑封装在Control panel MCM.mqh包含文件中，主文件仅负责初始化、反初始化和事件转发。由于没有开仓、平仓、止损止盈或仓位管理的任何逻辑，它不具备任何交易能力。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but a chart control panel utility. It initializes the MCM panel via InitControlPanelMCM with customizable appearance parameters including background color, font color, selection color, and font size. In OnChartEvent, it processes CHARTEVENT_CUSTOM and higher custom events, printing event ID, symbol, timeframe description, and price when custom events arrive, suggesting use in multi-currency market watch scenarios. DeinitControlPanelMCM cleans up panel resources on EA removal. The core logic is encapsulated in the Control panel MCM.mqh include file, while the main file only handles initialization, deinitialization, and event forwarding. Since there is no logic for opening, closing, stop-loss, take-profit, or position management, it possesses no trading capability whatsoever.
pros: 提供可自定义外观的控制面板界面，用户可根据喜好调整颜色和字号
支持多币种市场观察事件的自定义事件处理，便于监控多个品种
代码结构清晰简洁，初始化和反初始化流程规范，资源管理得当
pros_en: Provides a customizable control panel interface where users can adjust colors and font size to their preference
Supports custom event handling for multi-currency market watch events, facilitating monitoring of multiple symbols
Clean and concise code structure with proper initialization and deinitialization flow and sound resource management
cons: 核心逻辑封装在外部mqh文件中，主文件无法体现面板的完整功能和实现细节
仅打印事件信息而无进一步处理逻辑，实用性有限，缺乏交互反馈机制
没有错误处理机制，如面板初始化失败时仍返回0而非INIT_FAILED
cons_en: Core logic is encapsulated in an external mqh file, so the main file does not reveal the panel's full functionality and implementation details
Only prints event information without further processing, limiting practical utility and lacking interactive feedback mechanisms
No error handling mechanism; returns 0 even if panel initialization might fail instead of returning INIT_FAILED
improvements: OnInit应检查InitControlPanelMCM的返回值，失败时返回INIT_FAILED以符合MQL5规范
增加对自定义事件的响应式处理能力，如点击品种时跳转图表或执行相关操作
improvements_en: OnInit should check the return value of InitControlPanelMCM and return INIT_FAILED on failure to comply with MQL5 conventions
Add responsive handling for custom events, such as switching charts or executing actions when a symbol is clicked

risk_points: 不执行任何交易操作，无财务风险
依赖外部mqh文件，若该文件被篡改可能引入恶意逻辑
risk_points_en: No trading operations executed, no financial risk
Depends on external mqh file; if that file is tampered with, malicious logic could be introduced
